cards.name: Double Shot
cards.flavor: Two shots, so close together they sound like one.

versions.effects: You make two [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attacks (1A), each against a different creature.
Evade 1, then as 2 AP.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack x2 | different | evade 1

cards.name: Rolling Shot
cards.flavor: You keep moving, and the shot rides along with the motion.

versions.effects: Evade 1, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A).
Evade 2, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 1d6 | evade 2

versions.effects: Evade 3, then make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 2d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 2d6 | evade 3

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.flavor: Nothing moves in your sight without an arrow following it.
cards.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares moves closer to you or to an ally.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against the triggering creature. On a Tier 2 or 3, it is Hindered (EoT); on a Critical, it is also Pushed 2.

cards.name: Covering Shot
cards.flavor: You see the blow coming before they do, and your bolt gets there first.
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 10 squares.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the attacker. On a Tier 3, the ally takes half of the triggering damage.

cards.name: Marksman's Shot
cards.flavor: One shot, carefully placed. Everything after it is easier.

cards.name: Volley
cards.flavor: You empty the quiver skyward, and the arrows fall together.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.flavor: Nobody walks through that ground without paying for it.

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Strike] Actions, and allies in it gain +1 Defense.
versions.ruler: rounds 3 | area 2 | allies 2 | banes 1 strike; defense 1 allies

cards.name: Pinning Shot
cards.flavor: You pin their foot to the ground with an arrow.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged] Weapon Attack (1A). On a Tier 2 or 3, the target is Immobilized (EoT).
versions.ruler: vs ad | tiers 0 / 1[W] + [Mod] / 1[W] + [Mod] | on 2+: debuff Immobilized (EoT)

cards.name: Twin Shot
cards.flavor: Two arrows, one motion, two answers.

versions.effects: Make one [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) and compare its result to two different creatures no more than 5 squares apart. It deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi to each of them.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | each extra 1d6 | area 2

cards.name: Hunter's Focus
cards.flavor: You and the quarry, and nothing else in the world.

versions.effects: For the rest of the encounter, against your Marked Quarry (a new Marked Quarry when you choose one): you gain 1 Boon and are Empowered against them, and you take less damage from each of their Actions, reduced by your **Signature Modifier** (you choose which instance of its damage is reduced).
versions.ruler: always: boon 1 encounter shot strike quarry; empowered 1 encounter shot strike quarry

cards.name: Deadeye
cards.flavor: You put everything into one shot, and everything into the one after.

versions.critical: The target is Blinded for 1 round.

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.flavor: Arrows fall from nothing, again and again, until the ground is gone.

cards.name: Deathmark
cards.flavor: One arrow, one name, and nothing left to argue.

versions.effects: Against your [[Marked Quarry]], this Action has 1 Boon. If the target goes Down, you can choose a new Marked Quarry (0R) and make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against them.

cards.name: Open Season
cards.flavor: You call it, and every arrow in the party finds the mark.

versions.effects: Make a [Ranged, Shot] Weapon Attack (1A) against your [[Marked Quarry]]. For 1 round, they are Vulnerable 2, and [Strike] Actions your allies make against them deal an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.
versions.ruler: does Weapon Attack | always: vulnerable 2 round

cards.name: Mark Quarry
cards.flavor: One name, one face, and the rest of the field goes quiet.

versions.effects: The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry: at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R [Focus] when yours died or went Down.
The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry instead of the one you had.

cards.name: Advance
cards.flavor: You press forward, one deliberate step at a time.

versions.effects: When you use this Action, you move up to your Speed in squares.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.

versions.effects: Advance in a [[Straight Line|straight line]] toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within your Reach. You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an unwilling creature's space is Difficult Terrain), even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last **empty** square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target. That Weapon Attack counts toward At-will Banes.

cards.name: Crawl
cards.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

versions.effects: You move 1 square.
**Requirements:** Your Speed is 5 or higher. You move 3 squares.

cards.name: Evade
cards.flavor: You slip through the fray without giving anyone an opening.

versions.effects: Evade 1.
Evade half your Speed (rounded down).

cards.name: Fists
cards.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.

cards.name: Haul
cards.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.
cards.vs: Appeal or Body (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: Your Reach is 2 or more. The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours and is at least 2 squares away. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

cards.name: Interact
cards.flavor: You pull the lever, open the door, grab what you need.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: draw an object you carry into a free hand; stow an object you hold (put it away on your person, such as sheathing a sword); swap two objects (stow the one you hold and draw another, in the same Action); grab objects within Reach, as many as you have free hands; help a Prone creature within Reach stand up; help an Imperiled creature within Reach get to safety; wake an Unconscious creature within Reach; open a door, chest or something similar. This Action is broader than most: it can be used for similar things in the world.

cards.name: Leaning
cards.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, you calculate cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level. You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost.

cards.name: Regrip
cards.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands. Regrip doesn't have the Handle trait: it doesn't need a free hand.

cards.name: Release
cards.flavor: You let it go.

versions.effects: You drop an object in your square, or let go of an object you hold with one hand (a two-handed weapon is then held with one hand).

cards.name: Reload
cards.flavor: You work the mechanism and seat a fresh bolt.
cards.requirements: You or an ally within Reach is wielding an unloaded weapon.

tiers: Your next Reload attempt gains 2 Boons.
You Reload the weapon. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.
You Reload the weapon and its wielder can Evade 1. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.

cards.name: Relocate
cards.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

cards.name: Shove
cards.flavor: You put your weight behind it and drive them back.
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

cards.name: Stand
cards.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

versions.effects: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

cards.name: Steel Yourself
cards.flavor: You grit your teeth and find a little more to give.

versions.effects: You use 1 Rally Point.
You use 2 Rally Points.

cards.name: Trip
cards.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

cards.name: Weapon Attack
cards.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.

cards.name: Break Free
cards.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.

versions.effects: You are no longer Immobilized.

cards.name: Rusty Knife
cards.flavor: A notched blade, quick and dirty.

cards.name: Dirty Trick
cards.flavor: Sand in the eyes, a heel on the toes, and the goblin is gone.

versions.effects: Hindered (EoT).

cards.name: Cudgel
cards.flavor: A heavy stick and no reason to hold back.

cards.name: Low Blow
cards.flavor: No rules in a back alley.

cards.name: Cleaver
cards.flavor: A butcher's blade, swung by someone who enjoys it.

cards.name: Brutal Swing
cards.flavor: The orc puts its whole weight behind one wild arc.

versions.effects: Prone.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.flavor: Touch its kin, and the orc answers.
cards.trigger: An ally within 2 squares is hit.

cards.name: Chilling Touch
cards.flavor: Fingers of fog, and the cold goes straight to the heart.

cards.name: Dread Whisper
cards.flavor: It knows your name, and it says what you fear most.

versions.effects: Frightened of the Grave Wisp (EoT).

cards.name: Club
cards.flavor: A tree trunk with a handle.

cards.name: Ground Slam
cards.flavor: The ogre brings both fists down, and the ground jumps.

cards.name: Rally the Tribe
cards.flavor: One bellow, and the whole tribe fights harder.

versions.effects: Allies within 5 squares gain 1 Support Boon on their next [Weapon] Action.

cards.name: Stick and Slip
cards.flavor: In, a quick cut, and out before they can answer.

cards.name: Guarded Cut
cards.flavor: The blade strikes and comes straight back to guard.

tiers: [V] 1d10 + [Mod] Sl; you gain +1 Armor Defense for 1 round.

cards.name: Reaping Sweep
cards.flavor: A wide, heavy arc for anyone standing too close.

cards.name: Hooking Chop
cards.flavor: The beard of the axe catches, and you pull.

cards.name: Rending Chop
cards.flavor: A blow that splits armor and leaves the flesh open.

cards.name: Ringing Blow
cards.flavor: A crack on the helm, and their next swing goes wide.

tiers: [V] 1d8 + 1 + [Mod] Bl; its next [Strike] Action takes 1 Pressure Bane (EoT).

cards.name: Bowl Over
cards.flavor: All the weight of the head, low and through.

cards.name: Lunge
cards.flavor: A full extension that reaches farther than they thought.

cards.name: Keep Them Off
cards.flavor: The point stays between you and them, and it pushes.

cards.name: Gut Punch
cards.flavor: A fist with a blade in it, right under the ribs.

cards.name: Skirmish Shot
cards.flavor: Loose, and be gone before the arrow lands.

cards.name: Heartseeker
cards.flavor: A full draw, aimed where the armor gives.

cards.name: Sting
cards.flavor: A small bolt in the leg: small, and enough.

cards.name: Lock & Loose
cards.flavor: A bolt to the knee, and they go nowhere.

tiers: [V] 1d4+2+[Mod] Pi; For 1 round, the creature is Hindered until they use a Move Action.
versions.ruler: on 2: debuff Hindered (until it moves); on 3: debuff Immobilized

cards.name: Point Blank
cards.flavor: Too close for a bow. Not too close for this.

versions.effects: While you are Engaged, this attack takes 1 Bane for it instead of 2.

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.flavor: The shot and the smoke, and they are on the ground.

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Your weapon blazes with holy light.

versions.effects: The target sheds [[Bright|Bright light]] in a 1 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to [[Hide]], for 1 round.
As 1 AP, but a 2 Emanation.

As 2 AP, and you or one ally in the Bright light gain [[Guard]] 1d8 + [Mod] (2d6 + [Mod] at Stage 2, 2d8 + [Mod] at Stage 3). The other creatures in the light, you excepted, are Pushed 1, away from the target.

cards.name: Lay On Hands
cards.flavor: Your touch carries your god's mercy.

versions.effects: The target can use 1 Rally Point.
The target can use 1 Rally Point, healing 1d6 + your Power Modifier more.
As 2 AP, but 2 Rally Points.

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards.flavor: A shimmer of light holds steady between them and harm.
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage you or an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The damage that Strike deals to the target is reduced by 2d6 + your Power Modifier (3d6 at Stage 2, 4d6 at Stage 3).

cards.name: Rebuke
cards.flavor: Strike my friends, and feel why you should not have.
cards.trigger: An enemy within 5 squares makes a [Strike] Action against an ally.

tiers: [R] 1d8 Ho; Pushed 2, and Frightened of you for 1 round.
versions.ruler: on 1: push 2; on 1: debuff Frightened (EoT); on 2: push 1

cards.name: Holy Wrath
cards.flavor: For one blow, your god stops holding back.

cards.name: Word of Radiance
cards.flavor: You speak a word, and light pours from your hands across everything that stands against you.

cards.name: Bulwark of Faith
cards.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.
cards.interrupt: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 5 squares.

versions.effects: The target gains [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage. After the damage, they are Slid 1.

cards.name: Beacon
cards.flavor: You plant your feet, and light rims the shoulders of everyone near you.
cards.target: You and allies in the Area

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, you and allies in the [[Aura]] gain +1 Defense. While the Beacon is active, you gain the following Action:

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth, and the earth answers.

versions.effects: For 3 rounds, enemies in the area take 1 Bane on [Weapon], [Power] and [Signature] Actions, and allies in it heal 1d4 at the start of each of their turns.
versions.ruler: rounds 3 | area 2 | allies 2 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4

versions.effects: As 2 AP, but for 5 rounds.
versions.ruler: rounds 5 | area 2.5 | allies 2.5 | banes 1 strike power; heal-dice 1d4

cards.name: Miraculous Recovery
cards.flavor: You lay both hands on the wound and call in a debt owed to your god.

versions.effects: The target heals twice what 1 Rally Point would heal, and you end one non-permanent effect of your choice on them.
As 2 AP, but three times what 1 Rally Point would heal.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.flavor: You reach out, and your god answers before you finish the prayer.
cards.interrupt: You or an ally within 5 squares would go Down.

versions.effects: Instead of going Down, the creature's total damage becomes 1 less than their Health Pool, and they gain [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals.

cards.name: Final Verdict
cards.flavor: You name every sin within reach, and the light answers all at once.

versions.effects: You roll once and compare the result to each target's AD. Each target you hit is Pushed 1 and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round. A Bloodied target is Prone instead; a Strained target also gains Bleed [R] 1d6 Ho (Mi/Ap).

cards.name: Hallowed Dawn
cards.flavor: Dawn breaks where you stand, and it chooses sides.

versions.effects: You and each ally in the Area heal 3d6 + your Power Modifier (4d6 at Stage 2, 6d6 at Stage 3) and end one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left. Each enemy in the Area is Pushed 2 away from you, takes 1 Bane on its [Strike] Actions and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round.
